to: clients and observers near the attacker (`xy_emit`), and the target in all cases. A reflected projectile goes to clients near the reflecting target, and to the original attacker in all cases

confirm.note: Every sender calls `commence_attack`, which builds the object; a reflection re-sends the same object (`info.action`) changed in place

senders.what: `commence_attack`: the `skill` handler. `attack` and `heal` call the `skill` handler.
Monster attacks and monster skills (`fireball`, `frostball`, `zap`, `deepfreeze`) in `update_instance`.
Cavalry NPCs, cave actors and the `rimeshatter` ability of a `rimedjinn`.
A reflection in `complete_attack`: the target reflects a magical projectile. The server sends the same `action` object again with `attacker` and `target` swapped.
